Grade: PP2
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 4
Topic 4.3: Writing WRITING

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing WRITING, part of Strand 4 in PP2 LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: Where do we place our WRITING readiness strand, the learners should where they turn pages from right to left as books when writing?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.
